sourceAuthority: Official LEGO product image and official LEGO building instructions

references.role: Production Design Target; crop of the official completed-model photograph
references.note: Crop isolates the completed alien carrier from the human extraction station also pictured in the set photograph; two small white background masks remove only the unrelated station at the crop edge. No Mothership pixels are changed or synthesized.

references.role: Official completed-model instruction illustration and construction cross-check
references.note: Official instruction page shows the whole carrier with its center craft, paired side craft and two outer circular modules docked. The full page is retained; only the instruction illustration, not the page arrow, was used for silhouette verification.
LEGO-hosted 500×462 product image; it shows the completed Mothership above a separate human extraction station from the same set. The lower station is excluded from the target.
LEGO-hosted 76-page PDF. Printed pages 28–49 build the main carrier, 50–56 the two side craft, 57–63 the center craft, and 64–68 the outer disc modules and assembled mothership.

references.role: Official LEGO separation configuration shown in the director review
references.note: Crop of LEGO printed page 50 showing the mothership carrier hull with three detached craft. It is an official instruction illustration and is not reconstructed, recolored, or composited.

verifiedSourceFeatures: Flattened, interrupted circular black carrier hull with an open central machinery channel.
Long multi-blade tail creates a strong front-to-rear direction.
One central/front craft, two paired seated side craft and two outer circular modules are docked in the completed source arrangement.
Black and dark-gray construction with bright lime conduits and translucent lime elements.
Official printed instruction page 50 shows the main carrier with three separate craft; paired side craft retain their round disk modules and guns.
Printed page 68 shows the fully assembled mothership with those craft docked.
boundedUnknowns: The source does not determine game launch/recovery timing, roster or capacity.
Reverse-side clearances and exact production joints are T084 checks.
The official product image is small; official instruction pages remain the construction reference.
The design package approves appearance in both source-shown configurations only; it does not define the gameplay event, timing, detached-unit names, roles, or control.
